issues.openingTypeRequired: No opening style picked for this sash — hardware and cut lists need one.
issues.glassTooThick: {{thickness}} mm glass exceeds the sash's {{max}} mm limit.
issues.flyScreenNotAllowed: This frame profile doesn't accept a fly screen.
issues.sashWeightExceeded: Estimated {{weight}} kg exceeds the catalogue's {{max}} kg limit (estimate).
issues.irregularOutline: The overall outline isn't a rectangle. That's allowed — stepped assemblies are real — just check it's what you meant.
issues.disconnectedPanels: The panels aren't all joined — one or more is floating free. Resize or move them until every panel shares an edge with another.
issues.archObstructed: The arched head is partly blocked by another panel resting on it — that carves a void inside the assembly rather than at its own outline. Still fabricable — just check it's what you meant.
issues.archBendRadius: Head radius {{radius}} mm is below the {{min}} mm minimum bend radius for this profile (indicative limit).
issues.dividerProfileRequired: This panel is split into more than one section — pick a divider profile.
issues.sectionTooSmall: This section is narrower than 150 mm — too small to glaze.
issues.gridMismatch: The section grid doesn't add up to the panel size.
issues.dividerMisaligned: This divider doesn't line up with the coupled panel next to it.
issues.archOnOpening: The arched top section is set to open — check the sash clears the curve.
issues.archWithMullion: An arched head can't have a vertical divider — only a single column is supported.
issues.slidingLayoutRequired: Pick a sliding layout for this section.
issues.slidingBlocked: Sash {{sash}} can't slide — its neighbours are on the same rail. Move it to another rail.
issues.slidingIntoFrame: Sash {{sash}} would slide into the frame. Use the suggested direction.
issues.slidingRailsRequired: The frame profile has no rail count — set it under Data → Profiles.
issues.slidingRailOutOfRange: Sash {{sash}} sits on rail {{rail}}, but the frame profile only has {{rails}} rails — move it back or pick a layout.
issues.slidingIntoNeighbour: Sash {{sash}} would slide into sash {{neighbour}}, which is on the same rail.
issues.slidingEmptyRail_one: Rail {{rails}} is empty — a {{used}}-rail frame would be cheaper.
issues.slidingEmptyRail_other: Rails {{rails}} are empty — a {{used}}-rail frame would be cheaper.
issues.slidingOnHinged: This frame isn't a sliding system, but a sliding layout is set. Re-pick the frame or set the section to Fixed.

design.deletePanelBlocked: This panel can't be removed — an assembly needs at least one panel, and removing this one would leave the rest disconnected.
